prompt: A young woman wearing brown leather boots, glasses, a tan trench coat, and a thick red scarf walks through a cold, rainy Japanese-style alley at night, her breath visible in the air. She sees an elderly man struggling to push a wooden oden cart with a glowing red lantern, so she drops her leather duffel bag and rushes to help. They push the cart together through the wet alley, then share a warm smile. The elderly man gives her a newspaper-wrapped roasted sweet potato. When she opens it, the steaming potato glows with warm golden magical light and tiny sparkling embers. She takes a bite with her eyes closed, smiling peacefully as sparkles drift around her, while the elderly man pushes his glowing cart into the distance. Cozy, emotional, cinematic, photorealistic, atmospheric night lighting, shallow depth of field, warm magical glow, 4K.
